interface.title: ViewAlign 1.33.3 (MSA-viewer)
interface.field: Molecular evolution / comparative genomics (DNA and protein multiple sequence alignments, e.g. SINE subfamilies, coding genes)
interface.stage_of_work: Inspecting, editing and analysing an alignment after it is built, then exporting it for figures or follow-up analysis
interface.what_it_is_for: A browser-only, GeneDoc-style alignment viewer and editor. You can shade and edit alignments, realign blocks with MAFFT or MACSE, translate and check codons, cluster rows into subfamilies, find motifs and repeats, draw dot plots and build trees, then export SVG, RTF, FASTA or Newick.

data.note: The main demo is examples/svk_k4.fa (40 SVK SINE sequences, 231 columns, subfamilies K1–K4), loaded with ?url=. For codon analysis, MACSE, search, repeats and the dot plot I loaded examples/synthetic/synth_msa.fa (6 coding sequences with synonymous, missense, stop, frameshift and deletion variants) the same way. I also loaded examples/synthetic/synth_ref.gb to check GenBank input. No files were uploaded.

features.name: Threshold conservation shading
features.general: Shade each column of a grid by the fraction of rows that agree, using up to three adjustable cut-offs and a choice of whether to count gaps
features.specific: Shade panel: Black, Dark and Light sliders with colour swatches, Reset buttons and enable boxes, plus Shade By Non-Gap or All
steps: open Shade
drag the Black, Dark or Light threshold slider (the lower thresholds follow to stay consistent)
choose Shade By Non-Gap or All
Reset a level to its default
serves_tasks: Shade columns by how conserved they are

features.name: Variable-columns-only view with breakpoints
features.general: Collapse the columns where all rows agree so only informative positions show, with a minimum number of differing rows and markers where columns were hidden
features.specific: Display > Variable sites only, % or count selector, ≥N seqs slider and box, Breakpoints marker
steps: tick Variable sites only
choose % or count
set the threshold (e.g. ≥8 seqs)
keep Breakpoints on to see where columns are hidden
serves_tasks: Show only the columns that vary

features.name: Consensus row builder
features.general: Make a majority or ambiguity-code consensus with a threshold and minimum coverage, show it above or below the grid, and copy it
features.specific: Consensus panel: Threshold, Min Cov, Type Normal or Ambiguous, Fallback, Position Top or Bottom, Copy Consensus, Copy Sel Consensus, + Consensus Below
steps: open Consensus
set Threshold and Min Cov
choose Normal or Ambiguous
Copy Consensus (to the clipboard as FASTA)
serves_tasks: Compute and copy a consensus sequence

features.name: Block selection with MAFFT realignment
features.general: Box a sub-region of rows and columns and realign just that region in the browser, leaving the rest of the alignment untouched
features.specific: Drag a box on the grid, then Alignment > Realign Block (FFT-NS-2, gap open and extension penalties)
steps: drag a box over rows and columns
open Alignment and pick the speed and gap penalties
press Realign Block
read the toast for the rows and columns realigned
serves_tasks: Realign a selected rectangular block

features.name: GeneDoc-style edit modes
features.general: Pick an edit tool from a toolbar, then click cells to insert or delete gaps or type residues
features.specific: Edit toolbar: Move NoGaps, Slide KeepGaps, Ins/Del Gap Seq, Ins/Del Gap Other, Ins/Del Gap All, Type, Select Col, Delete Cols, Clear Gap Cols (only Ins/Del Gap Seq and Type were used in this run)
steps: press Edit
choose a mode (e.g. Ins Gap Seq)
click a cell in a row
switch to the opposite mode (Del Gap Seq) or Type and press a key
serves_tasks: Insert or remove gaps in one sequence
Change a single residue

features.name: Named undo history
features.general: Step back through a list of named changes and pick the one to undo, whatever kind of edit it was
features.specific: Undo history dropdown listing entries such as 'Realign block' and 'Type residue (K1_001)'
steps: make an edit or realignment
open Undo history
click the entry to undo
check that the alignment went back
serves_tasks: Undo a change from the history list
Change a single residue

features.name: Codon analysis overlay
features.general: Put a translation under each coding sequence in the chosen reading frame and genetic code, and mark stop codons, amino-acid changes and frameshifts
features.specific: Codon bar: Pos 1, Pos 2, Pos 3, Auto, Genes frame; Code; Frameshifts vs Most rows or Row 1; AA only; Copy AA; Save AA
steps: tick Codon analysis (Auto picks the ATG frame)
read the translation, where red * marks a stop and ! a frameshift
switch to AA only to see the protein alignment
Save AA or Copy AA
serves_tasks: Translate the sequences and flag stop codons, missense changes and frameshifts
Save the translated protein sequences

features.name: MACSE codon-aware realignment
features.general: Realign coding sequences so codons stay in frame, with separate costs for frameshifts and stops
features.specific: MACSE… sets Sequence type to Coding (MACSE v2.07 exact) with frameshift and stop costs; Realign All, Realign Selected or Add & Align
steps: press MACSE… on the codon bar
check the frameshift and stop costs
press Realign All
check the translation (beta_fs is back in frame)
serves_tasks: Realign coding sequences in a way that respects codons and frameshifts

features.name: Subfamily clustering with group explorer
features.general: Split rows into groups automatically by diagnostic positions or k-mer distance, then rearrange, show or hide the groups and box the columns that tell them apart
features.specific: Clustering > Find SNP groups or Group by k-mer (method, distance, linkage, k), Group explorer (On/Off, Gather all, Hide colours, find sequence), Show 2D rectangles
steps: press Find SNP groups (or Group by k-mer)
read the group counts with exclusive and shared positions
Gather all to put each group's rows together
toggle a group Off
Show 2D to box the supporting regions
serves_tasks: Group sequences by shared diagnostic positions
Group sequences by k-mer similarity instead
Reorder rows by group and hide a group's colours
Box the regions where groups share or differ

features.name: Interactive distance-tree viewer
features.general: Build a UPGMA or neighbour-joining tree from all rows or the selected rows, change the layout, re-root or swap branches by clicking, open a clade on its own, and export it
features.specific: Alignment Tree dialog: Method UPGMA or NJ, Model, rooted or unrooted layout, Click swap branches or re-root, View subtree, SVG, PNG, Copy Newick, Download .nwk
steps: select rows (optional) and press Actions > Tree
choose UPGMA or NJ and a distance model
switch the layout to unrooted and press Fit
set Click to re-root and click a branch, then View subtree
Download .nwk or SVG
serves_tasks: Build a distance tree of all sequences
Re-root the tree and look at one clade
Build a tree from chosen rows only
Save the tree for other software

features.name: Motif search and restriction-site finder
features.general: Highlight one or more saved motif searches (exact, regex or with mismatches) in their own colours, and pick restriction enzymes from a list
features.specific: Search panel: motif box, .* regex, mismatches, colour, Find, Active searches list, Search both strands, Restriction Sites enzyme grid with Find Sites
steps: type a motif and press Find
manage the Active searches
open Restriction Sites
tick enzymes and press Find Sites
serves_tasks: Highlight a sequence motif in every row
Mark restriction enzyme sites

features.name: Repeat finder
features.general: Search one sequence, all sequences or the selected rows for tandem, direct or inverted repeats (or SINE target-site duplications), with a length and divergence cut-off, and highlight the hits
features.specific: Repeat Finder: Tandem, Direct, Inverted or TSD (SINE); One sequence, All or Selected rows; Min length; Max divergence; results table; click a row to highlight
steps: open Actions > Repeats
choose the repeat type and scope
set Min length and Max divergence
press Find and click a result to highlight it
serves_tasks: Find repeated stretches inside a sequence

features.name: Split-diagonal dot plot with region collection
features.general: Compare two sequences (or one with itself) on a dot plot that uses different methods above and below the diagonal, pin points, rank the similar stretches, and keep the ones you want
features.specific: Dot Plot: upper SPIN word length, lower Dotter window and identity, RevComp B, Live update or Recalculate, click to pin, Top Regions with →/☆, Collection with TSV, Export PNG or SVG, Copy region
steps: right-click a row name > Dot-plot (self)
set the word length or window and identity
click the plot to pin a coordinate
Recalculate and read Top Regions
star a region into the Collection or export
serves_tasks: Compare a sequence with itself in a dot plot

features.name: Publication export of the shaded alignment
features.general: Export the alignment as it is drawn, as a vector figure or a Word-compatible coloured document, or save the sequences as FASTA
features.specific: Input > Snapshots: SVG (viewport), Full SVG, RTF; Save button for FASTA
steps: set the shading, colours and consensus
open Input
press SVG or RTF
press Save for FASTA
serves_tasks: Export the shaded alignment as a figure or Word document
Save the sequences as a file
